settings.subtitle: Yokohama makes some of the most balanced premium tires in Calgary — quiet, long-wearing, and fairly priced. We stock the Geolandar A/T G018 (all-terrain), iceGUARD iG53 (winter), ADVAN Sport (performance), and Geolandar AT XD G017 (truck off-road) at 111 42 Ave SW.
settings.intro_heading: Why we recommend Yokohama in Calgary
settings.intro_richtext:
Yokohama has been making tires in Japan since 1917 — the oldest tire manufacturer in Asia. They're best known in Calgary for the Geolandar truck/SUV line and the ADVAN performance line, both of which deliver quiet, predictable handling at a friendlier price than Michelin or Bridgestone.

The Geolandar A/T G018 is our most-installed Yokohama. 3PMSF-rated all-terrain that handles Deerfoot daily and gravel runs to Ghost Lake or out east toward Strathmore. The Geolandar AT XD G017 is the heavier-load LT version for ¾-ton trucks and trailers.

For dedicated winter, the iceGUARD iG53 uses a hydrophilic compound that stays grippy on Calgary's January black ice and packed snow. For sport sedans and coupes, the ADVAN Sport delivers max-performance grip with surprisingly civilized noise.

Every Yokohama we install gets the same balance, calibrated torque, and TPMS reset — and we price-match local Calgary competitors. Book installation or call (403) 452-4283.
settings.cta_description: Stocked Yokohama sizes installed same-day. Price-matched against any local Calgary competitor on the same model.
settings.faq_1_q: What's the best Yokohama tire for Calgary winters?
settings.faq_1_a: The iceGUARD iG53 for sedans and crossovers — Yokohama's dedicated winter tire with hydrophilic compound that holds grip on Calgary's January black ice. The Geolandar A/T G018 also carries 3PMSF rating, so it works as a year-round option for trucks and SUVs.
settings.faq_2_q: Geolandar A/T G018 vs AT XD G017 — which one?
settings.faq_2_a: G018 is the P-metric (passenger-rated) version for half-ton trucks, SUVs, and crossovers. AT XD G017 is the LT (light-truck) version with higher load ratings for ¾-ton and larger trucks, or any vehicle towing heavy. Both 3PMSF rated.
settings.faq_3_q: How much do Yokohama tires cost in Calgary?
settings.faq_3_a: Yokohama tires at Prince Tires range from $220 to $350 per tire. ADVAN Sport starts around $220; iceGUARD iG53 around $235; Geolandar A/T G018 around $320; AT XD G017 around $280 in mid-range sizes.
settings.faq_4_q: Is Yokohama as good as Michelin or Bridgestone?
settings.faq_4_a: Yokohama is a peer-tier brand — same Japanese precision, friendlier price. For pure premium safety and longevity, Michelin tops it. For pure quiet, Bridgestone's Turanza is hard to beat. For best-balanced premium-adjacent at a 20–30% lower price, Yokohama is our go-to recommendation.
settings.faq_5_q: Can I get same-day Yokohama install in Calgary?
settings.faq_5_a: Yes for most stocked sizes if booked before midday. The Geolandar A/T G018, iceGUARD iG53, and ADVAN Sport are reliably in stock in common Calgary sizes. Trucks need a 60-minute slot — call (403) 452-4283 to confirm.
settings.faq_6_a: Geolandar A/T G018 carries a 60,000-mile (96,000 km) treadwear warranty. ADVAN Sport and Geolandar AT XD G017 are non-warrantied (industry standard for max-performance and LT tires). iceGUARD iG53 is non-warrantied (industry standard for dedicated winters). All include Yokohama's defect warranty.
